scope: read-only native FullTask evidence audit; no simulation or source changes

solver.readback_scope: USD articulation schema; installed tensor/binding API has no native iteration getter
solver.baseline_scope: explicit 64/4 candidate and 64/4 development setting; no claim of original default solver equivalence

turn_pacing.scope: time pacing of existing collision-checked targets; unchanged acceptance gates

feedback_reference.limitation: median twist reconstruction; raw relative speed, off-axis, contacts and final acceptance remain separate

turn_diagnosis.scope: No turn action has been observed in this prefix

episode_scope.scope: historical physical continuation diagnostic only; not a valid FullTask episode

turn_diagnosis.interpretation: Actual and planned palm are compared against the original plan right-close reference in initial-Core coordinates. Layer mapping reconstructs median twist and cannot resolve off-axis dispersion. No torque is inferred.

contact_inference_method.method: World contact point nearest actual cubelet geometric center marker; each source local COM marker transformed by its actual actor pose. Compare nearest selected9 versus other17 external cubelets. Core is the 18th remaining body but has no collider.
contact_inference_method.impulses: Scalar positive impulse magnitudes accumulated across contact callback points, not force or signed tangential impulse
contact_inference_method.ambiguity: Points close to a selected/other nearest-center boundary or too far from all markers stay ambiguous
contact_inference_method.limitations: Geometric association is estimated, not recovered actor identity. Contact distribution alone does not establish resisting torque; tangential impulse vectors were not recorded.
